notes.title: LUNA the Shadow Dust is now OUT!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

We are happy to tell you that after developing for 4 years, LUNA The Shadow Dust, a fully hand-animated Point&Click puzzle adventure is now OUT!

And in the first week, please [b]enjoy your 10% off discount! [/b]And hope you will like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/465100/LUNA_The_Shadow_Dust/

[h1]Traditional frame by frame character animation[/h1]
12 frames per second, 3 layers per frame. Over 250 animations and 20 minutes of cinematics. A nostalgic and time-consuming process - but really worth the challenge for a small indie team of four.


[h1]Single player mode with dual character control[/h1]
Solve puzzles from different perspectives. Discover a story of true courage with two playable characters drawn together through an inseparable bond.


[h1]Think outside of the box[/h1]
Spark your imagination and solve a wide variety of puzzles, presented in gorgeous hand-drawn environments. Puzzles work standalone, requiring no 'hidden items' or player backtracking.


[h1]LESS reading, MORE cinematics[/h1]
We replaced a dialogue system with a series of beautifully hand-animated cinematics telling a mysterious story.


[h1]Engaging Original Soundtrack[/h1]
Our composer created an original soundtrack, designed to immerse the player in the emotional highs and lows of the story, kindling goose-bumps along the journey.

Hope you will like it! And please share this news to your friends! So that more people would know our game! And thanks very much!!!

notes.title: Enlightenment V1.1.0 | Update log
notes.notes:
Hi there, we are pleased to inform you that Enlightenment is no more an Early Access game. Today, Enlightenment has been finished and released, and here is the update log of what's new in this version

[h1]UPDATE[/h1][list]
[*]Now there are 8 levels instead of 6, and a final BOSS is added
[*]The weapon plug-in system has been replaced with more random parameters
[*]Refine the damage number effect
[*]6 more new enemies
[/list]

[h1]FIX[/h1][list]
[*]Fix the problem that the injections cannot be used in Seahorse Cabaret
[*]Fix the problem that using some weapons may cause error
[*]Replace the English localization
[*]Improve the tutorial
[/list]

Though Enlightenment is no more an Early Access game, we will keep updating it and use this version as a new direction, to bring more better features and contents in the future! Thanks for your support, and feel free to ask or leave comments if you have any problems or feedbacks, we would be glad to help!

notes.title: Enlightenment | Critical Update | Beta 1.0
notes.notes:
Hi guys and gals, it has been 5 months since last update, please accept our sincere apology. Here we would like to show you what have we done in the past months:

1. [b] Update main levels.[/b] Now there are 6 instead of 2 main levels (and we haven’t even take hidden levels into account). In new levels, more enemies, items and guns are added. Enjoy!

2. [b]Meet the “event” rooms.[/b] Now player can find some special rooms by chance when discovering levels, and you can get random items or buffs as rewards... But only if you can meet the requirements...

3. [b]More skills to draw.[/b] Now Thotep (the Mojo merchant) will show up in the camp and lift, and the way he sell items is different now.

4. [b]Critical update on weapon system.[/b] Else than rebalancing the values, a plug-in system has been added to enhance the gameplay and usability.

5. [b]Say goodbye to the annoying random injections.[/b] Now there is only separate healing injection. They are randomly placed in the map for you to discover. To use them, hit the “F” key.

6. [b]Modify on the mechanic to use items.[/b] Now players can use items by consuming Telekinesis, and Telekinesis can be get by defeating enemies. Technically speaking, all skills can be used as many times as you want.

7. [b]A safety zone (a lift) has been added between levels.[/b] And provide different functions.
[olist]
    [*]Save & Quit
    [*]Reset the plug-ins of weapons
    [*]Redraw new skills
[/olist]


8. [b]A new female NPC has come to the camp.[/b] She has plenty of handy weapons for sale!
9. [b]Redesign the UI.[/b] For display the content in a better way.

In short, there are lots of things updated, we hope they deserve your time. Now pick up your equipment and enjoy this brand-new Enlightenment!

PS: Due to the quantity of this update, the save data from previous versions are incompatible in current version. So please start a new game. And the players with old save data can get 20 Illumilets automatically.

notes.title: Enlightenment Update | Seahorse Cabaret
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
After weeks of preparation, the Seahorse Cabaret is open for business now!
The Seahorse Cabaret is specifically tailored as the perfect place for entertaining players who have suffered in the Ark for a long time. You can enjoy an exciting variety show-like fight, practice your skills, and earn a lot of illumilets. The Seahorse Cabaret is open to those experienced adventurers who have enough Ragtime Reputation.

On top of that, Thotep has a special deal for everyone:
During the grand opening, the Cabaret is open to everyone, anytime.
During the grand opening, all the weapons and items are unlocked in the Cabaret.
All the offers above are only available in the Seahorse Cabaret.
[spoiler]All the offers above will only be available in the first week...[/spoiler]

"Why don't you play the game of life, and let go the days idled away?" - Thotep

notes.title: Enlightenment | Beta Update 0.12
Enlightenment | Beta Update 0.12
[Game Update] Beta 0.11
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, thank you for all the support, and all the wonderful words we’ve received about the game. We really appreciate it, and we’ll keep working to make Enlightenment even better!

Today we've pushed out a new patch to everyone that includes various optimisations and bug fixes. 

List of fixes and changes:
- Fixed some controller issues 
- Added several options of display resolution
- You can see your ranking on easy mode now
- Added a little interval after using the tools, to avoid misuse 
- Fixed an issue that the killed spiders may still follow you for a while
- Fixed the lag phase when using the shotgun
- Fixed the wrong number displayed, of keys and papers 

Moreover, there are some important questions we'd like to answer:

Q: Will there be a keyboard changing system in the future?
A: We're working on it and it takes time.

Q: Are there only two chapters? When will you update the new chapters?
A: More chapters can be expected in the nearly future. And a new mode - 'Survival' will be updated in this months, August 2017.

notes.title: The early access of “Enlightenment” is now available.
notes.notes:
Today is August 4th, a memorable day. Thanks to everyone’s support, our game has finally launched Steam. Although it’s only the early access, there are already lots of contents in the game. You can enjoy those well-designed scenes, enemies, items and weapons in the game. 

Here are some follow-up update plans: 

From now on, we will add as much items, weapons and mojos as we can so that there will be more possibility and pleasure during this game. 
We will add a new game mode called “survival mode”. It will be available in August if not delayed.
We have designed some interesting elements for the game. Please allow us to keep it a secret for now. You will see those new elements soon.
